questions.question: What is the central question of chapter 28?
options: Where is the gold mined and found?

questions.question: Where did Job conclude wisdom is found for man?
options: In the deep and hidden places of the earth
In the very deepest mines of the purest gold
In the fear of the Lord and turning from evil
In the far and distant reaches of the wide sea
questions.answer: In the fear of the Lord and turning from evil

questions.question: Job said wisdom cannot be bought with gold or precious stones.
'The fear of the Lord, that is _____.'
Job said man knows how to mine silver and gold but not the place of _____.
